{{Top|leg}}
'''Zhaboka Battalion''' was a unit in [[Rusher's Brigade]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Named for the [[Zhaboka/Legends|weapon]], the battalion fought in the [[Battle of Gazzari]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. The unit was later reformed into [[Team Zhaboka]].
